verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships Loop, a built-in AI agent. Users can ask it in natural language to investigate logs and to build scorers, datasets and dashboards. It can also generate datasets, and through Patterns it runs on a schedule to find recurring problems in traces and suggest fixes. This is clear in-product task delegation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Loop's effectiveness, and in-depth docs on Loop's scope, limits and approval/control flow.
